body.x: Famppy Corp., (CEO HAEJIN PARK) participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.

IT content creator company Famppy is conducting various projects under the mission of "providing a novel experience that connects customers to the real and digital world." They have developed XR Engine, which produces content on a proven web-based platform, and recently released a beta version of the XR content creation tool based on the development. According to a company representative, the company is composed of top level XR engineers and designers in the country, optimized for Metaverse, and is made up of practical technical personnel.

In terms of technology, the company has been selected as an excellent technology company, a technology venture company, an innovation/main business company, and in terms of design, it has been selected as a promising design company by the Korea Institute of Design Promotion. In terms of service, it has been selected as an edutech company by the Ministry of Education and the Education Research Information Service and has conducted various trials with various institutions and beta services. Recently, it has been preparing for the official introduction of the service by conducting a PoC with Daekyo. In addition, it has also received international certifications such as ISO 9001 (quality certification) and ISO 27001 (information security certification) and is recognized for its skills.

Famppy's "APOC (A Piece of Content)," which is set to be officially released in 2023, is a web-based, no-coding XR content creation tool service that allows anyone to easily create XR content in a browser. Just like Powerpoint, it allows users to easily create XR content with simple clicks and drag-and-drop functionalities, and can be used by distributing the content with just one click. It has the advantage of being able to create 2D, 3D, AR, VR, and XR content without a developer in a hybrid manner.

A Famppy representative said, "With the advancement of technology, it is expected that realistic and interactive content will gradually flourish. However, currently, these types of content can only be produced by receiving the help of experts or by being configured with software and receiving education." They explained the background of the development saying, "Just like photos and videos, without the constraints of devices or infrastructure, we have developed a convenient web-based, no-coding creation tool & platform that allows anyone to easily create and experience interactive XR content."

They continued and expressed their ambitions, "We plan to participate in CES 2023 to discover potential customers and to observe the reactions of various customers from different countries towards our new products. In addition, through the exhibition, we plan to secure awareness and establish a foundation for effective entry into the US market. After the official release of APOC, we plan to open a content trading market to allow creators to buy and sell their own content. Through this, we plan to create and trade a variety of commerce, education, and marketing content and build an economic system."

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The K-STARTUP Joint Pavilion featured joint participation of institutions like the Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development, Seoul Business Agency, and Seoul Digital Foundation, as well as 51 Korean innovative companies, to enter the US market and discover global partners. In addition, university student supporters of CES 2023 chosen by each university (Kyunghee, Kookmin, Sogang, Chung-Ang) matched to participating companies based on their respective majors and fields of business.
